summary: Full backend + frontend regression suite for Phases A-D (canon rename, Grand Teleporter, Waystones, Homeland Reputation, Exploration Progress, Formal Professions). Wrote 24 pytest cases: 23 passed, 1 skipped (teleporter-cooldown carry-over between runs). All 5 UI acceptance areas verified in a live logged-in Playwright run: TRADES panel (professions-panel, 19 catalog entries, LEARNED tags on Fishing/Hunting, 2/3 slots + 'next unlock at Lv 25'), TELEPORTER panel (all 8 destinations, HERE marker on Mushkara, 100g fee visible on the seven remote hops), WORLD tab (11 continent cards including 3 dashed/locked ones and the EXPLORATION - Mushkara section with 4 biome bars + n/5 milestones lines), HUD tab bar (BIOME/WORLD/INVENTORY/FORGE/SKILLS/TRADES/TELEPORTER/OATHSPIRE/RIVERGUARD/GRUNHOLD/SOLUNARA/WARFORGE/GUILD HOUSE/JOURNAL/LADDER/EXIT all present). Existing Erethon character was correctly migrated to canonical continent (verified not on any legacy id).
action_items: Consider stashing the seven-day abandon cooldown check inside learn_profession() — abandon_profession() writes an `abandoned_professions[id].abandoned` ISO timestamp but nothing enforces the seven-day block on relearn. Currently a player can abandon+relearn immediately.

Non-blocking: the World tab shows race names in ALL-CAPS with underscores (HUMAN, HALF_ELF). Consider mapping to 'Human'/'Half-Elf' for polish. Same for BEST IN: rows in the Trades panel ('DAW_UL_TALALU' vs 'Daw'ul Talalu').
critical_code_review_comments: world_travel.teleporter_can_use(): the hometown-only guard (`current_town` must be set) is enforced on `teleporter/travel` but NOT surfaced in the `teleporter/destinations` GET. A player standing in a biome (current_town=None) sees the destination cards as clickable — clicking a card 403s with 'The Grand Teleporter is only in a hometown.' Consider adding an `is_available` flag to each destination card and greying it out in TeleporterPanel.jsx.

server.py teleporter/travel: after a successful hop the player is dropped in the tier-1 BIOME of the new continent (`dest_cont['biomes'][0]['id']`), NOT the hometown itself — but current_town IS set to the hometown. Result is an inconsistent 'you're in Grunhold but the biome around you says Red Steppe' state. Consider setting current_town=None on arrival, mirroring what waystone/travel already does; or keep current_town=hometown and set current_biome=None. Right now both are set which is the odd case.

professions.abandon_profession() writes `abandoned_professions[id].abandoned` (an ISO timestamp) but nothing reads it. The 7-day 'reclaim cooldown' from the spec is never enforced — `learn_profession()` will happily accept a just-abandoned profession.

server.py POST /game/action Phase-C exploration logic: for non-explore actions the delta is halved via integer division. Outcomes 2 (delta 0) and 3 (delta 2//2=1) still nudge progress; outcome 1 was max(0, -2//2)=max(0,-1)=0 - so critical failures during hunt/gather never actually lose progress. Only true 'explore' actions get the -2 penalty. Fine per spec wording ('half rate') but worth documenting.

server.py POST /game/professions/learn: even when `payload.profession_id` is missing entirely, `learn_profession(ch, None)` returns 'Unknown profession.' with a 400. That's OK but a Pydantic model would give clearer 422s. Nice-to-have.

professions.py: `PROFESSION_RANK_XP['grandmaster']=10_000_000` is a sentinel — `rank_from_xp` still returns 'grandmaster' correctly when xp >= 5th tier total. However, `rank_from_xp` iterates `PROFESSION_RANKS` (which starts with 'novice') and its loop mistakenly credits the first iteration to 'novice' before advancing. Trace: with xp=0, first pass compares `xp < 0+200`  →  True  →  returns 'novice'  →  OK. With xp=200, compares 200 < 200  → False, advances total to 200, rank='novice', next iteration checks 200 < 200+600 → True → returns 'novice' (should be 'apprentice'). Off-by-one — the rank advances one step too late. Consider `if xp < total + need: return rank` after moving `rank = r` up.

server.py get_current_town/teleporter flow: teleporter/travel doesn't add the character's current_biome to visited_biomes (no such field exists). If you later want per-continent 'visited biomes' analytics you'll need this.

success_rate.backend: 100% (23 passed / 1 skipped due to cooldown carry-over from prior test hop)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 acceptance areas verified — HUD tabs, TRADES panel, TELEPORTER panel, WORLD tab, exploration bars)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login goes through the 'Sign In' link on the homepage; there is no /login route. After login the frontend routes to /game. All 11 continents come back from /api/game/data/continents including azurea/vael_turog/orinth with locked=true. Waystone data-testids are consistent (e.g. teleporter-dest-daw_ul_talalu, prof-cat-blacksmithing, explore-bar-red_steppe). Erethon's location will drift between test runs because the teleporter test relocates it; the migration test is now robust to that. If you need to re-verify the golden Valeria/Golden Plains state, ask the main agent to reset the character. There is a known rank_from_xp off-by-one (see critical_code_review) and the 7-day relearn cooldown is not enforced — flagged as non-blocking. Profession rank never crosses in these tests because the L10 character only has 88xp on hunting, well under the 200xp/novice ceiling.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found. Minor code-review items and one edge case (rank_from_xp off-by-one at exact-threshold XP) are documented above for E1 to address opportunistically.
